key.name: failure-grace-seconds
key.summary: Seconds a failed connection gets to come back before it is reported
key.description: A Wi-Fi roam that fails once, an access point that restarts or a brief drop usually reconnects within seconds; nothing is shown when the device is connected again by then.

key.name: notify-when-other-link-online
key.summary: Also report a lost connection while another connection keeps the computer online
key.description: Off: the Wi-Fi of a computer that is online through its cable (or the other way round) can drop without a notification.

key.name: repeat-interval-seconds
key.summary: Minimum seconds between two notifications for the same device
key.description: A flapping link produces at most one notification per interval; the notification goes away by itself when the device is connected again.
